name: Bugaboo Ant adapter for car seats – Nuna/Cybex
seatBrandsSupported: Per Bugaboo's official 91510CS01 page: Bugaboo Turtle One by Nuna, Bugaboo Turtle Air by Nuna, Nuna Pipa Lite, Cybex Aton 2, Cybex Aton Q, Cybex Cloud Q, and — explicitly — the Clek Liing. So although the adapter is marketed as 'Nuna/Cybex' and the Clek Liing is usually described as a Maxi-Cosi-style seat, the manufacturer itself lists the Liing as compatible, corroborating Clek's official list; the Liing mounts on the same Nuna/Cybex bracket footprint. NOTE: Bugaboo's official page does NOT list Maxi-Cosi; some third-party retailers (e.g. Dearborn Baby) add 'Maxi Cosi' to the compatibility blurb — treat that as an unverified retailer claim, not manufacturer-stated. Adapter-mounted seats are limited to 28.7 lb child weight.

install.pieces: adapter set that clicks onto the Ant frame; infant seat then clicks into the adapter
install.notes: Bugaboo 'click-and-go' style mount, no tools. Adapter-mounted car seat weight limit 28.7 lb (child).

notes: VERIFIED CLEK-LIING FIT: Clek's list files the Bugaboo Ant under this 'Nuna/Cybex' adapter (91510CS01), which at first looks like a footprint mismatch (Liing is often called Maxi-Cosi-style). But Bugaboo's own product page explicitly names the 'Clek Liing' as a compatible seat for 91510CS01, so the fit is manufacturer-confirmed — the Liing rides on the Nuna/Cybex bracket, not a Maxi-Cosi one. No discontinuation flag on Clek's list. Availability: shown out of stock on Bugaboo DTC (listed ~$29.97, was $49.95) but in stock at retailers (Dearborn Baby $41.97, was $59.95). Reconfirm exact price/stock at checkout. Only single-mode use applies (Ant is a single stroller).
